summary: Completed testing of Offline Support feature with Dexie.js IndexedDB integration. All core offline features working correctly: SyncStatus component shows online/offline status, IndexedDB caching for interventions/clients/categories, pending actions queue, and optimistic updates for start/complete intervention.

minor_issues.issue: Console warning '[OfflineDB] Failed to get pending actions: DexieError' on page load - caused by complex Dexie query with .where().or() pattern
minor_issues.impact: No functional impact - fallback to filter works correctly

minor_issues.issue: React warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'
minor_issues.impact: Accessibility warning only, no functional impact

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix Dexie query in getPendingActions() - use simpler filter approach instead of .where().or()
critical_code_review_comments: offlineDb.js: Well-structured Dexie database wrapper with proper error handling and fallbacks
OfflineContext.jsx: Comprehensive offline provider with auto-sync, pending actions queue, and network status listeners
TechnicianApp.jsx: Properly integrates offline context for caching interventions, clients, and categories
ACTION_TYPES exported correctly for use in pending actions queue
Optimistic updates work correctly for start/complete intervention when offline
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing interventions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline Support feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) IndexedDB 'ActoosOfflineDB' v20 with 6 stores (interventions, clients, categories, pendingActions, pendingPhotos, syncMeta), 2) SyncStatus component shows 'En ligne'/'Hors ligne' with pending count badge, 3) Data caching works - 12 interventions, 1 client, 6 categories cached, 4) Start/Complete intervention works with optimistic updates, 5) Minor Dexie query warning on load (non-blocking). Dexie.js v4.4.1 installed.
